reason: A offers the more composition-specific and physically plausible mechanism—Cu-rich surface segregation/premelting driven by Cu’s lower melting point and unfavorable mixing—and a direct falsification test using simultaneous thermal imaging and elemental mapping. Its baseline and extrapolation from bulk Co–Cr–Cu–Ni evidence are imperfect, but B’s vaguely defined “chemical disorder” is not cleanly manipulated by annealing, which may instead induce segregation, phase changes, or coarsening and thus confound the proposed test.
